name: Project Scaffold & Configuration
description: Initialize the Vite + React + TypeScript project with bun create vite. Configure vite.config.ts (port 4000, build output dist/, inline vitest config). Install and configure Tailwind CSS v3 (pinned), React Router v6, Convex npm package. Set up tailwind.config.js with custom infrastructure colors, font families (Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono, Inter via Google Fonts link tags in index.html), and the bg-grid utility via Tailwind plugin. Create the global CSS entry point importing Tailwind directives with dark near-black background (#0a0a0a), subtle grid pattern utility, and font-face assignments. Configure tsconfig.json with strict mode, react-jsx, bundler moduleResolution. Ensure bun.lockb is the only lockfile. Add scripts to package.json: dev, build, test. This component produces ONLY static configuration files and the platform on which all other components build. It does NOT produce React components, Convex schema/functions, or route definitions.

functions.name: generate_scaffold
functions.description: Generate the complete project scaffold: create all 11 configuration files, install dependencies with bun, and produce bun.lockb. This is the primary entry point. Idempotent: re-running on an existing scaffold overwrites files to match the canonical state.

inputs.name: project_root
inputs.description: Absolute filesystem path to the project root directory. Must be an empty or non-existent directory.

validators.error_message: project_root must be an absolute POSIX path

error_cases.name: bun_not_found
error_cases.condition: bun executable is not found on PATH

error_data.detail: bun must be installed (https://bun.sh). npm and yarn are not supported.

error_cases.name: directory_not_writable
error_cases.condition: project_root does not exist or is not writable

error_data.detail: project_root must be a writable directory

error_cases.name: bun_install_failed
error_cases.condition: bun install exits with non-zero status (network error, registry unavailable, version conflict)

error_data.detail: bun install failed; check network connectivity and package version availability

error_cases.name: directory_not_empty_with_conflicts
error_cases.condition: project_root contains existing files that conflict with scaffold files (e.g. a non-scaffold vite.config.ts) and idempotent overwrite is blocked by read-only permissions

error_data.detail: Cannot overwrite existing files due to filesystem permissions

functions.name: verify_scaffold
functions.description: Run all verification checks against an existing scaffold installation: file existence, lockfile exclusivity, dev server startup, build success, and test runner execution.

inputs.name: project_root
inputs.description: Absolute filesystem path to the project root directory containing the scaffold.

validators.error_message: project_root must be an absolute POSIX path

error_cases.name: bun_not_found
error_cases.condition: bun executable is not found on PATH

error_data.detail: bun must be installed to run verification checks

preconditions: project_root exists and contains scaffold files
bun is installed and available on PATH
postconditions: VerificationResult reflects the actual state of the scaffold on disk
If all_files_exist && no_forbidden_lockfiles && dev_server_starts && build_succeeds && tests_run, the scaffold is fully valid
errors list is empty if and only if all boolean fields are true

structured_side_effects.description: Reads scaffold files to verify existence and content
Checks for forbidden lockfiles (should not exist)
Starts dev server briefly to verify it binds to port 4000

performance_budget.complexity: O(1) file checks + O(n) build verification in dependency count

invariants: Exactly 11 files are produced by the scaffold (package.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, index.html, src/index.css, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, .env.local.example)
bun.lockb is the only lockfile; package-lock.json and yarn.lock must never exist
Dev server always runs on port 4000; this is non-configurable
Build output always goes to dist/; this is non-configurable
The convex/ directory is NOT created by this component — it is owned by the data_layer component. However, tsconfig.json must include 'convex/_generated' in its includes array
All Tailwind infrastructure color tokens use static hex values; per-tool accent colors use Tailwind arbitrary value syntax (e.g. bg-[#3b82f6]) and are NOT registered in tailwind.config.js
Google Fonts are loaded via <link> tags in index.html with display=swap, never via @font-face in CSS
src/main.tsx creates a ConvexProvider using import.meta.env.VITE_CONVEX_URL — it does NOT import or configure ConvexReactClient with any other options
src/main.tsx wraps the app in StrictMode > ConvexProvider > BrowserRouter > App
The bg-grid utility class is registered via a Tailwind plugin using addUtilities(), not via custom CSS in index.css
TypeScript strict mode is always enabled
vitest configuration is inline in vite.config.ts via the test property, not in a separate vitest.config.ts
All package version ranges use caret (^) for minor version flexibility within the major version constraint
src/App.tsx is a minimal placeholder component; downstream components (app_shell) replace its contents
src/index.css contains only Tailwind directives (@tailwind base/components/utilities), body background color, and font-family assignments — no component-specific styles

data_access.rationale: This component reads and writes only project configuration files (package.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, tsconfig.json, etc.) and a .env.local.example template. All files are PUBLIC-tier source code artifacts committed to version control. The .env.local.example contains only a placeholder URL, not actual credentials. The actual .env.local with real VITE_CONVEX_URL values is .gitignored and not produced by this component. No PII, secrets, or INTERNAL data is accessed.

side_effects.rationale: Writes 11 project configuration and entry point files to the project root. All are PUBLIC source code files intended for version control.
bun install produces bun.lockb as a binary lockfile. This is a PUBLIC build artifact committed to version control for reproducible installs.
bun install fetches npm packages from the public npm registry. No authentication tokens or private registries are used.

authority.rationale: This component is the sole authority for project-level configuration files and build toolchain setup. It owns: (1) package.json structure, dependency versions, and scripts; (2) vite.config.ts including dev server port, build output, and vitest configuration; (3) tailwind.config.js infrastructure color tokens, font families, and the bg-grid utility plugin; (4) tsconfig.json compiler options and include paths; (5) postcss.config.js plugin chain; (6) index.html structure including Google Fonts links and root mount point; (7) src/index.css Tailwind directives and global styles; (8) src/main.tsx provider hierarchy (StrictMode > ConvexProvider > BrowserRouter). No other component may modify these files without coordinating through this contract. The data_layer component owns the convex/ directory, and the app_shell component owns the contents of src/App.tsx beyond the placeholder.
